attributes.description: Steam Cloud sync passes by outcome.

query.query: data_stream.dataset: "steam.cloud" and event.action: ("cloud-sync-started" or "cloud-sync-completed" or "cloud-sync-deferred" or "cloud-sync-not-needed" or "cloud-download-completed" or "cloud-file-upload-started")

attributes.title: Cloud sync activity

embeddableConfig.description: Steam Cloud sync passes by outcome.

attributes.description: Sync passes started and deferred, by game.

query.esql:
FROM logs-steam.cloud-*
| WHERE event.action IN ("cloud-sync-started", "cloud-sync-deferred")
| LOOKUP JOIN steam_lookup.app_name ON steam.app.id
| EVAL application = COALESCE(steam.app.name, steam.app.id)
| STATS Started = COUNT(*) WHERE event.action == "cloud-sync-started", Deferred = COUNT(*) WHERE event.action == "cloud-sync-deferred" BY application
| SORT Started + Deferred DESC
| LIMIT 10

query.query: data_stream.dataset: "steam.workshop" and event.action: ("workshop-item-subscription-added" or "workshop-item-downloaded" or "workshop-item-removed" or "workshop-item-details-lookup-failed" or "workshop-item-details-update-failed" or "workshop-item-manifest-changed")

attributes.title: Workshop activity

embeddableConfig.description: Workshop items subscribed, downloaded, removed or failing to update.

attributes.description: Failed Workshop operations by game and result.

query.esql:
FROM logs-steam.workshop-*
| WHERE event.outcome == "failure"
| LOOKUP JOIN steam_lookup.app_name ON steam.app.id
| EVAL application = COALESCE(steam.app.name, steam.app.id)
| STATS failures = COUNT(*), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY application, action = event.action, result = steam.workshop.item.result
| SORT failures DESC
| LIMIT 20
